verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch ships AI features, so a training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions AI training, an opt-out setting, or a data-use policy for its AI features. Self-hosting with "full data ownership" is an adjacent deployment option, not a documented guarantee or control against model training, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
